name: Blox Fruits
summary: Blox Fruits codes for 2x Experience, stat resets and money, with where to redeem them and which ones we've tested.
about:
Blox Fruits is one of Roblox's biggest games, made by Gamer Robot Inc and inspired by One Piece. You sail between islands across three seas, fight NPCs and bosses, and level up either as a sword user, a gun user, a fighting-style user, or a Devil Fruit user.

Most codes listed here give 2x Experience for a set time, which is the fastest way to push through the level grind. Others give a free stat reset, so you can rebuild your build without paying, and a couple give small amounts of money or a title.

codes.reward: The in-game title BIGNEWS (only applies in the Second or Third Sea)

redeemSteps: Click the gear icon in the row of icons on the left of your screen.
In Settings, scroll down to Gameplay and find Redeem DLC Code.
Click the yellow Redeem button next to it.
Type or paste a code into the Enter Promo Code box, then press Redeem.

redeemImage.alt: Blox Fruits gear icon, the Settings window with Redeem DLC Code, and the Redeem Codes box

troubleshooting.a: Codes are case-sensitive, so use the Copy button rather than typing them out.
Each code works once per account.
Older guides say to use a gift icon at the bottom left. The current route is through Settings, as shown above.
The code has probably expired. None of the codes here have been tested by us yet, so if one fails for you, tell us through the contact page.

faq.q: Where do you redeem Blox Fruits codes now?
faq.a: Gear icon on the left, then Settings, scroll to Gameplay, click Redeem next to Redeem DLC Code, and type into the Enter Promo Code box. The screenshots on this page show all three steps.

faq.q: Why do older guides say to use a gift icon?
faq.a: That was the old route. Codes now go through Settings. If a guide still shows the gift icon, it hasn't been updated in a while.
The Blox Fruits Wiki reports that experience codes add their time together when you redeem several. We haven't tested this ourselves yet.

faq.q: Which code gives the most 2x Experience?
faq.a: According to the Blox Fruits Wiki, GAMER_ROBOT_1M gives the most at 1 hour 30 minutes, then SUB2GAMERROBOT_EXP1 at 30 minutes. The rest are listed at 20 minutes each.

faq.q: Do stat reset codes cost anything?
faq.a: No. KITT_RESET and Sub2UncleKizaru are listed as free stat resets, which normally cost in-game money, so they're worth saving until you actually want to rebuild your build.

faq.q: Why does fudd10 only give 1 Money?
faq.a: The Blox Fruits Wiki lists it, and Chandler at 0 Money, as joke codes from the developers. They're not worth rushing for.
